statement.description: A guy named Vasya attends the final grade of a high school. One day Vasya decided to watch a match of his favorite hockey team. And, as the boy loves hockey very much, even more than physics, he forgot to do the homework. Specifically, he forgot to complete his physics tasks. Next day the teacher got very angry at Vasya and decided to teach him a lesson. He gave the lazy student a seemingly easy task: You are given an idle body in space and the forces that affect it. The body can be considered as a material point with coordinates (0; 0; 0). Vasya had only to answer whether it is in equilibrium. "Piece of cake" — thought Vasya, we need only to check if the sum of all vectors is equal to 0. So, Vasya began to solve the problem. But later it turned out that there can be lots and lots of these forces, and Vasya can not cope without your help. Help him. Write a program that determines whether a body is idle or is moving by the given vectors of forces.
statement.formatI: The first line contains a positive integer $ n $ ( $ 1<=n<=100 $ ), then follow $ n $ lines containing three integers each: the $ x_{i} $ coordinate, the $ y_{i} $ coordinate and the $ z_{i} $ coordinate of the force vector, applied to the body ( $ -100<=x_{i},y_{i},z_{i}<=100 $ ).
statement.formatO: Print the word "YES" if the body is in equilibrium, or the word "NO" if it is not.

translation.description: 有一个叫 Vasya 的男孩正在上高三。一天，Vasya 决定去看他最喜欢的冰球队的比赛。由于他非常热爱冰球，甚至超过了物理，所以他忘记做作业了，特别是物理作业。第二天，老师很生气，决定给 Vasya 一点教训。老师给了这个懒学生一个看似很简单的任务：现在给出一个静止在空间中的物体，以及作用在它上的若干个力。我们可以把这个物体看作是坐标为 $(0,0,0)$ 的质点。Vasya 只需要回答这个物体是否处于平衡状态。“小菜一碟”——Vasya 想道，我们只需要判断所有力的矢量和是否等于 $0$。于是 Vasya 开始解决这个问题。但后来发现，这些力的数量可能非常多，Vasya 无法独立完成。请你帮帮他，写一个程序判断给定这些作用力时，物体是否静止或者正在运动。
translation.formatI: 第一行包含一个正整数 $n$（$1 \leq n \leq 100$），接下来有 $n$ 行，每行包含三个整数，分别表示作用在物体上的力的 $x_i$、$y_i$、$z_i$ 坐标分量（$-100 \leq x_i, y_i, z_i \leq 100$）。
translation.formatO: 如果物体处于平衡状态，输出单词 "YES"；否则输出单词 "NO"。
